## smoke_bugs

```yaml
- id: dynamics_step_shape_mismatch
  status: seed
  description: dynamics.step returns a state with the wrong rank or dimension count.
- id: collision_check_too_strict
  status: seed
  description: The collision model rejects every candidate state or edge.
- id: planner_no_path_found
  status: seed
  description: The planner exhausts its time/iteration budget and returns no path.
- id: state_bounds_violation
  status: seed
  description: Sampled or propagated states escape the environment state bounds.
- id: control_dim_mismatch
  status: seed
  description: The planner samples controls whose dimension does not match the dynamics.
- id: value_net_never_updates
  status: seed
  description: 'Network parameters are identical before and after training: the RMSprop
    update (Algorithm 1 line 13) is skipped, detached, or applied to a copy.'
- id: norm_reward_penalty_inert
  status: seed
  description: The Spass/Sovtk/Scross penalty indicators never fire (wrong frame,
    wrong thresholds, or Rnorm never added to Rcol), silently reducing SA-CADRL to
    norm-free behavior.
- id: experience_sets_empty
  status: seed
  description: The experience sets E/Eb are never assimilated (Algorithm 1 lines 10-11),
    so every update samples from an empty set and training is a no-op or crashes late.
- id: epsilon_exploration_inert
  status: seed
  description: 'The epsilon-greedy exploration is dead: epsilon (or the x-reflection
    probability eps_f) is effectively 0 or never applied, so trajectory generation
    is purely greedy and alternative passing topologies are never explored.'
- id: policy_ignores_neighbor_state
  status: seed
  description: The value net or policy consumes only the self-state slice of the joint
    state (6 + 8*n_obs per Equations (7)-(8)); neighbor observations are dropped and
    the agent plans as if alone.
```

  stage: stage_2c_method

## pluggable_component

```yaml
name: train_and_plan
return_type: PlanResult
signature_template: 'train_and_plan(n_agents: int, n_episodes: int, *, seed: int,
  **paradigm_extras_by_name) -> PlanResult'
contract:
  fixed_positional_args: []
  seed_param: seed
  paradigm_extras_forwarding: by_name_from_config
  forbidden_param_names:
  - config
return_type_definition: 'PlanResult is a dataclass / namedtuple with fields:

  - trajectory: Trajectory | None

  - status: Literal["success", "timeout", "infeasible", "error"]

  - stats: Dict[str, Any]

  '
rationale: 'This family trains a policy before it can plan, so the

  pluggable is the end-to-end train-then-evaluate entry point

  (the SRL spec: "encapsulates SA-CADRL as an end-to-end

  training and planning pipeline"). Method-specific knobs

  (e.g. the source paper''s norm_type) are forwarded by name

  from params; they are not part of the family contract.

  Return type stays the family''s PlanResult so the inherited

  demo_success markers keep reading the headline demo.

  '
```

## arch_contract_requirements

```yaml
required_blocks:
  data_loader.load_data_returns:
    type: dict[str, shape_string]
    min_keys:
    - start
    - goal
    - environment
  architecture.value_net:
    required_subblocks:
    - class_name
    - forward.input
    - forward.output_type
  architecture.policy:
    required_subblocks:
    - class_name
    - forward.input
    - forward.output_type
  pluggable_component.name:
    must_equal: pluggable_component.name
  pluggable_component.input_shapes:
    type: dict[str, shape_string]
  pluggable_component.output_shape:
    type: shape_string
  training_loop:
    required_subblocks:
    - function_name
    - input_shapes
symbol_conventions:
  n_agents: number of agents the trained network is configured for (the paper's n)
  n_obs: number of observed neighbor agents; joint state is 6 + 8*n_obs per Equations
    (7)-(8)
  B: runtime batch size through the value network
family_components:
  reward_function:
    required: true
    description: 'Total reward R = Rcol + Rnorm the trained policy optimizes: the
      base collision reward plus the norm-inducing penalty over the Spass/Sovtk/Scross
      sets (Section III-A, Equations (9)-(12)), as method.py computes it.

      '
    required_entries: []
  value_network:
    required: false
    description: 'Optional alternate placement for the multiagent value network summary;
      the canonical placement is architecture.value_net (the SRL contract''s shape).

      '
    required_entries: []
  policy:
    required: false
    description: 'Optional alternate placement for the trained-policy summary; the
      canonical placement is architecture.policy (the SRL contract''s shape).

      '
    required_entries: []
```
